original_query: Which OS was used more among mobile Facebook users in October 2014, Android or Windows Mobile?

confirmed.answer_text: In October 2014, 76% of mobile Facebook users used Android.; In October 2014, 18% of mobile Facebook users used Windows Mobile.
confirmed.summary: The slide presents insights into smartphone and data consumption in Romania, specifically focusing on social media platform market share and the operating system (OS) split among mobile Facebook users in October 2014. It includes a bar chart of social media network usage in Romania in 2013 and a pie chart showing the OS distribution for mobile Facebook users.
key_facts: In October 2014, 76% of mobile Facebook users used Android.
In October 2014, 18% of mobile Facebook users used Windows Mobile.
